name: set_bookmark
description: Create or update a bookmark at a mapped hexadecimal address and report readback success. Omit name to preserve an existing name or create an unnamed bookmark; an empty string clears the bookmark name. This mutates navigation metadata; bookmarks are analyst-authored navigation aids, not binary evidence.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

document.description: The active target's provider document name; use open_binary to switch targets

name.description: Exact name used by this operation.
